scientific_integrity: Universal claim established by a symbolic residual-function proof and exact reachable-state counting; finite checker corroborates. No independent external verification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact closed state-count formula is for binary least-significant-digit-first complete DFAOs and shifts by powers of two, with all-zero padded representations included. The no-merging theorem also holds for arbitrary nonnegative shifts. No formula for general shifts or most-significant-first automata is claimed. Historic priority is conditional on inspected sources, and finite tests are not infinite proofs.
title: Exact dyadic-shift state complexity of all-one-pattern parity sequences
